model_annotations.Bulgarian: Това е таблица, която сравнява сложността на изхода и слоя при различни нива на рядкост, като използва Wandа. Най-добрият резултат е посочен с удебелен шрифт. Таблицата съдържа два метода: Per-Output и Per-Layer, всеки със съответните си стойности за различни нива на рядкост: $10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%$.
model_annotations.Chinese:
This figure presents a comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates. The horizontal axis lists methods, specifically "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer". The vertical axis represents perplexity values, ranging from 5 to 534, with increments of 100, 200, and then larger intervals, but the unit is not specified. 

The "Per-Output" bars are blue and have values approximately at 5.70, 5.81, 6.38, 7.17, 9.35, 20.46, and 534.42. The shortest bar is for "Per-Output" at 10% sparsity, and the tallest bar is also for "Per-Output" at 80% sparsity.

The "Per-Layer" bars are orange and have values approximately at 5.70, 5.82, 6.03, 6.56, 7.70, 39.02, and 886.10. The shortest bar is for "Per-Layer" at 10% sparsity, and the tallest bar is for "Per-Layer" at 80% sparsity.

There are no grouped or stacked bars, and no bars are sorted in a specific order or visually emphasized beyond color-coding by method.
model_annotations.English: The image presents a table and a blurred bar chart illustrating the perplexity of various methods at different sparsity rates. The table compares per-output and per-layer perplexity across sparsity rates of 10% to 80%, with two methods listed: Per-Output and Per-Layer. Per-Output perplexity values range from 5.70 to 534.42, while Per-Layer values range from 5.70 to 886.10. The bar chart, labeled Figure 5, displays a comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates, with a logarithmic scale used due to significant value differences between high and low sparsity rates.
model_annotations.German: This figure presents a comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates using two methods: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rates, which are labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, and the vertical axis represents perplexity values ranging from 5 to 534, with tick labels at regular intervals. The Per-Output method is depicted by one set of bars, and the Per-Layer method by another, with each set showing values at each sparsity rate. Notably, the Per-Output bars at 10%, 20%, 30%, and 40% sparsity rates have values around 5.70, 5.81, 5.99, and 6.38, respectively, while the Per-Layer bars at the same sparsity rates have values of approximately 5.70, 5.82, 6.03, and 6.56. As sparsity rates increase, the perplexity values for both methods also increase, with the Per-Output bars reaching around 534.42 at 80% sparsity and the Per-Layer bars reaching approximately 886.10. The best performance result for each sparsity rate is indicated in bold.
